Against SOURCE: his 'only in the form and timing that is useful, kind, stabilizing, and real' matches the draft plus the unchanged tail; 'a form' and 'will be useful' are the article’s existing wording, and 'help me know' (his 'understand') is untouched by this change, so it is not a defect of it. No new claim and no first-person fact: the 'I/me' is the invocation’s speaker, not Joel’s biography (T01, C03 absent; C04 not engaged). Tell rows, none PRESENT. Linter D9 'follows the source order': accepted. It is one clause in the order of his line with nothing to reorder, and T13/T09 do not apply to a clause. Linter O27 'ends with no period': accepted as an artifact of cutting. The draft is only the changed middle of a long sentence, and in the context that sentence ends 'real for me.' with its period inside the closing quote, so no period is missing in the article text.
